faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes G350d use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. Pre-2018 models (W463 generation) use the OM642 3.0-litre V6 diesel. From 2018 onwards (W463a), it switched to the OM656 2.9-litre inline-six diesel — a completely different engine. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your vehicle has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes G350d engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my G350d?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the OM642 or the OM656 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM642 G350d engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM656 G350d engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We service it to the same standard as our other G-Class rebuilds.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used G350d engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my G350d if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an G350d engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most G350d owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
